latestVersion.changelog:
Best-video 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Transform raw video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) into polished 1080p MP4 videos using cloud GPU processing.
- Simple onboarding: automatic backend connection, free trial token flow, and streamlined setup.
- Supports key workflows: AI-based video cleanup, fast video export, aspect ratio changes, text overlays, and audio track edits.
- Session-based editing lets users preview, refine, and re-export videos in one place.
- Clear error messages guide through file limits, credit checks, export eligibility, and authentication steps.
- Optimized for content creators, with rapid rendering (1–2 minutes for short clips) and plain-language prompts.
